hook.text: What is the Mandelbrot set, really?

text.formula: Square the number, add c, repeat: black = it never escapes
Zoom into the edge: the detail never ends
Fix c instead: every c has its own Julia set
Fold the plane first: a burning ship appears

youtube.title: One rule, repeated: the Mandelbrot set, Julia sets and the Burning Ship ❄ #shorts
youtube.description:
z → z² + c. Start at 0, repeat, and colour each c by how fast the orbit runs away.
